MOD = 1000000007

def add_mod(a, b):
    a += b

        a -= MOD
    return a

def mult_mod(a, b):
    res = a * b
    if res >= MOD:
        res %= MOD
    return res

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, N, M):
        self.N = N
        self.M = M
        self.data = [[0] * M for _ in range(N)]
        
    def clear(self):
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.M):
                self.data[i][j] = 0
                
    def set_identity(self):
        self.clear()
        for i in range(min(self.N, self.M)):
            self.data[i][i] = 1
            
    def transpose(self):
        t = Matrix(self.M, self.N)
        t.clear()
        for i in range(self.M):
            for j in range(self.N):
                t.data[i][j] = self.data[j][i]
        return t
    
    def get_row(self, r):
        return self.data[r]
    
    def set_row(self, r, row):
        self.data[r] = row
    
    def add(self, other):
        res = Matrix(self.N, self.M)
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.M):
                res.data[i][j] = add_mod(self.data[i][j], other.data[i][j])
        return res
    
    def multiply_by(self, scalar):
        res = Matrix(self.N, self.M)
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.M):
                res.data[i][j] = mult_mod(self.data[i][j], scalar)
        return res

    N, M = a.N, b.M
